metaTitle: How to Choose a Camping Hammock
description: Choose a camping hammock by length, width, capacity, fabric and suspension, and learn how to hang it, keep bugs out and stay warm underneath.
directAnswer: Pick a hammock 9 to 11 feet long that holds your weight with margin, use wide tree-friendly straps, hang it at about a 30 degree strap angle, and add a bug net, tarp and underquilt for real camping.
